SD46-CP01.name: Mogami Shunta
SD46-CP01.effect:
[Grandwalker Nexus]
This Nexus can only be affected by effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses. Cores can only be placed on this Nexus via Core Charge or effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses, and cannot be moved from this Nexus except via effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses.

[Core Charge: (Emperor Beast/Ten Crown/God-King/Worldswalker/Avatar & Cost 3 or more) (Imagine Brave)]
◆When you summon/advent a target Spirit/Brave, put a core from the Void onto this Nexus.
◆When this Nexus is deployed, if you do not control a Grandwalker Nexus with the same card name, you can send three cards from your decktop to the Trash. For each target card among them, put a core from the Void onto this Nexus.

When this card is revealed by "Bombardment"-named effects, send an opposing Life to their Reserve.

[Grand Skill: 2] [LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step)
(Once per turn, send two cores from this Nexus to the Void) Draw a card.

[During Seal] [Grand Skill: 1] [LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
(Once per turn, send one core from this Nexus to the Void) Destroy an opposing 15000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate.

SD46-X01.name: The BlueThunderGodKing Blitz-Tiger-Z
SD46-X01.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Destroy an opposing 8000 BP or less Spirit. Then, destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with the same family as the destroyed Spirit. These effects can't be prevented by "Armor"-named effects.

[LV1][LV2] [Seal: Seal] (When Attacks)
You can send [Soul Core] from this Spirit to your Life.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Return a "Z"-named Spirit card from your Trash to the Hand.

SD46-005.name: The NinthThunderclap ThreeSacredHorses Byerley-Dark-Z
SD46-005.effect:
When your "God-King" family Spirit attacks, you can pay one cost to summon this set card. When you've done so, you can set a card with Burst effect from your Hand.

[Burst: After Spirits/Braves are summoned by an opposing effect]
Destroy three opposing 12000 BP or less Spirits. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Draw two cards.

SD46-X02.name: The RedThunderGodKing Revol-Tiger-Z
SD46-X02.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Seal: Seal] (When Summoned/Attacks)
You can send this Spirit's [Soul Core] to the Life.

[Seal: During Seal] [LV1][LV2][LV3] [Grand Bombardment] (When Attacks)
You can reveal two cards from your decktop. For each "Z"/"Steel" among them, +1 core to any Red Grandwalker Nexus you control, and send an opposing Life to the Reserve. Add the revealed cards to the Hand.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing 15000 BP or less Spirit.

SD46-X03.name: The SteelThunderKing Igridios-Z
SD46-X03.effect:
When your Life would be reduced by an opposing effect, by paying one cost to summon this card from your Hand/Removed Zone, your Life won't be reduced.

Flash - [Accel: Cost 6 ([White Core][White Core][Red Core][Red Core])]
Return three opposing Spirits/Ultimates to the Hand. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto the Removed Zone.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Destroy an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate. Also, this attacking Spirit can't be blocked by opposing Spirits.

SD46-006.name: The SteelThunderKnight Licospiros
SD46-006.effect:
Flash - [Accel: Cost 6 ([White Core][White Core][Red Core])]
Return an opposing Spirit to the deckbottom. After this effect resolves, put this card onto the Removed Zone.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
For each three cards in the opposing Hand, put a core from the Void to this Spirit.

[LV2] (When Destroyed by the Opponent)
You can return this Spirit to the Hand.

SD46-007.name: The SteelThunderKnight Tigrigoreus
SD46-007.effect:
Main - [Accel: Cost 3 ([White Core][Red Core])]
Draw a card. After this effect resolves, put this card onto the Removed Zone.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Spirit/Nexus effects.

[LV2][LV3] (Opposing Attack Step)
This Spirit gains +3000 BP, and can block while exhausted.

SD46-003.name: Thunder-Z-Grizzly
SD46-003.effect:
Flash - [Accel: Cost 4 ([Red Core][White Core][Core])]
Destroy an opposing Brave, and draw a card. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto the Removed Zone.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Destroy an opposing Nexus. Also, when summoned from the Removed Zone, destroy an opposing 10000 BP or more Spirit/Ultimate.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13741.name: Thunder-Z-Hippogriff
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13741.effect:
Flash - [Accel: Cost 5 ([Red Core][Red Core][White Core])]
Destroy any amount of opposing Spirits/Ultimates, up to a total of 8000 BP. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto the Removed Zone.

[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit, and draw a card. Effects of the Spirit destroyed by this effect can't activate.

SD46-001.name: Thunder-Z-Puma
SD46-001.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, add an exactly-named "Mogami Shunta", and a Red/White "Worldswalker"/"Ten Crown"/"God-King" family Spirit card to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV1][LV2]
This Spirit's color and symbol are also treated as White.

[During Seal] [LV2] (Your Attack Step)
The amount of cards revealed by your [Bombardment]/[Twinkle Bombardment]/[Grand Bombardment] becomes three.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13799.name: Thunder-Z-Gibbon
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13799.effect:
Flash - [Accel: Cost 3 ([Red Core][White Core])]
Destroy an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto the Removed Zone.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
This Spirit can't be destroyed by opposing effects.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Main Step)
This Spirit gains an extra White symbol.
